text:
deploybot: Upcoming deploy window: embeddings-service v0.9.0 -> prod (canary 20:00 UTC, ramp 20:30).
incident-bot: New incident INC-9401: eu-central embeddings-cache eviction storms causing OOMs on workers.
rachael: ops asked to pause any rollouts that change cache eviction or TTL defaults.
owen: v0.9.0 increases prefetch TTL from 5m->10m; could be related.
manish: are the OOMs during heavy gc or steady load?
ops: saw memory spike during sustained prefetch bursts -> eviction thrash; suspected default TTL bump.
rachael: ok @deploybot pause rollout embeddings-service v0.9.0 and pin slot to v0.8.7. mark v0.9.0 quarantined.
deploybot: Command: `pause rollout embeddings-service v0.9.0` — Rollout paused. Slot pinned to v0.8.7. Auto-promote disabled.
owen: rollback snippet: `deploybot promote embeddings-service v0.8.7 --force --reason "INC-9401 eviction-oom"` — ready if needed.
manish: ops triage: testing lowering TTL back to 5m and enabling conservative prefetch rate-limiter in eu-central (staging looks healthier). ETA 15m.
release_coordinator: hold public changelog and change window notifications. internal release notes flagged quarantined.
rachael: timeline: tentative new window 03:30 UTC if triage clears. update calendar after confirmation.
ops: mitigation looks OK in staging; propose micro-canary 1% traffic with strict memory and error gates: memory > 85% or OOM -> abort.
owen: will add circuit breaker: `max-memory-percent: 80` and `oom-threshold: 2` to canary policy.
deploybot: Reminder: pinned slot blocks scheduled promotions. To unpin run `deploybot unpin embeddings-service`.
manish: rollback verification: run `embed-verify --region eu-central --check-memory` after promoting older version.
release_coordinator: prepping short customer note in case we need rollback — blocked until we know impact.
rachael: keep updates here. next check-in in 10m or on status change. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
owen: :thumbsup:
manish: :mag: 
incident-bot: INC-9401 updated: investigation in progress (labels: embeddings-cache, eu-central, high).
